section: Race summaries > Round 3 – China Shanghai International Circuit

entities.name: Nico Rosberg
entities.description: This forced Rosberg to drive conservatively to preserve his tyres while Button recovered from his disastrous pit stop to pass Sebastian Vettel for second. Rosberg became the 103rd person to win a Grand Prix.

entities.name: Jenson Button
entities.description: Button was held up by the incumbent World Champion long enough for Rosberg to preserve his tyres. Button was second.

entities.name: Lewis Hamilton
entities.description: Hamilton scoring his third consecutive third place, giving him a two-point championship lead over Button.

entities.name: Fernando Alonso
entities.description: Fernando Alonso, who had been leading the championship before the race, finished ninth.

entities.name: Romain Grosjean
entities.description: After two retirements in the opening rounds of the championship, Romain Grosjean scored his first points in Formula One by finishing sixth.

entities.name: Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team
entities.description: The result was also Mercedes's first win as a constructor since Juan Manuel Fangio won the 1955 Italian Grand Prix.

entities.name: Shanghai International Circuit
entities.description: The circuit where the Chinese Grand Prix was held.
